thread:
Maya: Anyone up for a quick crag sprint + picnic lunch today? Meet at south crag boulders by 12:15, low-key. Bring crash pads if you have one.
Alex: I’m in. Do we need a pad? I only have my light one.
Ben: I can bring my big pad but I’ll be biking so might be there ~12:25.
Claire: I’ll run over from the office, free to spot/photograph :camera_with_flash:
Sam: I’ll take the trail lap route — north stairs -> east park entrance, 10 min jog.
FitBot: Fitness reminder: Sunny, 72F, low wind. Great day for outdoor bouldering! :sun_with_face:
Alex: Poll: want to do short tech problems (30 min) or a sprint lap + one proj? React :boulder: for tech or :runner: for sprint.
Maya: Added micro-challenge — 3 dynos each on the slab. Loser buys post-lunch coffee :coffee:
Ben: Accepted. Also bringing extra tape and a small first-aid kit.
Claire: My dynos are cursed but I’ll try 😂
Sam: Playlist needed — throw in your recs, will queue for the walkover.
Alex: `https://open.spotify/playlist/0-example` — my jam for warmups.
Maya: If anyone needs a ride I have room for two, DM me. I’m leaving at 12:05.
Jamie: Can someone spot me for a rope-free topout? I’ll bring snacks as bribe :cookies:
Ben: Spotting yes, snacks = guaranteed safety :cookie:
Claire: Heads up — parking by the south lot is tight after 12:30.
FitBot: Reminder scheduled: Group meetup at 12:15. Good luck and be safe! :thumbsup:
Alex: OK see you all there. Maya — ping me if you need help hauling the pad.
Maya: Will do. See you soon! :sunglasses:
